description: Implementation of the BridgeStateManager class handling bridge interface state monitoring and updates, including event handling for netlink messages related to network bridge interfaces.

classes.name: BridgeStateManagerImpl
classes.description: Manages network bridge state, handles netlink events, and maintains cached bridge interface states.

methods.name: BridgeStateManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing bridge state monitor and reader, setting up event handler.

methods.name: read_state
methods.description: Reads and caches the current state of a specified bridge.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Retrieves cached interface names for a specified bridge.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Updates the cached interface list for a specified bridge.
